tdTop.why: Scored in 2 of his last 10 games (2 TDs in 5 games this season). 22 touches a game lately. LV projected for about 24 points.

tdAll.name: Kyren Williams
tdAll.label: Anytime TD
tdAll.research: He is the lead back near the goal line and scored twice late last week, but Corum takes about 38% of the carries and the market already prices him near 59%.

tdAll.name: Puka Nacua
tdAll.label: Anytime TD
tdAll.research: Nacua is healthy and back as the focal point, with 12 targets last week against a Bills secondary missing corners, but nothing points to a specific red-zone edge beyond the market's roughly 52-54%.

tdAll.name: James Cook
tdAll.label: Anytime TD
tdAll.research: Allen has scored a rushing TD in every game and handles much of the goal-line work, which limits Cook's scoring chances, but no source confirms the exact inside-the-5 split.

tdAll.name: Josh Allen
tdAll.label: Anytime TD
tdAll.research: Allen has nine red-zone carries, six inside the 10, and more inside-the-five carries than Cook. He has scored a rushing TD in every game this season.

tdAll.name: Davante Adams
tdAll.label: Anytime TD
tdAll.research: Buffalo is 29th in TD rate allowed to outside receivers and is missing corners, but Adams's target rate drops sharply with Nacua back, which leaves him relying on touchdowns.

best.name: Matthew Stafford
best.label: Passing yards
best.why: Stafford has gone over 283.5 in 6 of his last 10 and 3 of 4 this season, averaging 311.0 passing yards over the last 10. The line has moved up 4 since it opened at 279.5. BUF has allowed the 7th-fewest passing yards to QBs over its last 10. Kalshi traders put the over at 50%. Game total 54.5, LA -3.5.
best.why_research: Stafford has passed for 300 or more yards in three straight games, and Buffalo's pass defense is short-handed with DT Ed Oliver out and nickel Dee Alford questionable. The game is indoors with a total that rose to about 54.5, and a prediction market prices 275+ yards slightly above even.
